message.reasoning:
The question asks which services Ember owns now (today is 2026-06-30).

Looking at ownership records:
- Ember owns the ledger [valid 2025-11-13 to now] — so Ember owns the ledger.
- Atlas owns auth-gateway [valid 2025-12-23 to now] — earlier Ember owned auth-gateway until 2025-03-31, superseded. So Ember does not own auth-gateway now.
- billing-api: Dune owns now.
- webhooks: the correction note says a handover note wrongly recorded Ember as owner of webhooks; there's no actual ownership record for webhooks by Ember. The note says the handover of 2025-06-20 wrongly recorded Ember as the owner of webhooks. So Ember does not own webhooks.

So the only service Ember owns now is the ledger.
